00d7710561dc.name: Infernum Halo-launcher
00d7710561dc.plain: Add 1 to armour saving throws made for the bearer against ranged attacks from Aircraft models.

013f6d631fac.name: Shield Dome
013f6d631fac.plain: Each model that has a shield dome has a 5+ invulnerable save.

0275ddfe941e.name: Skyspear missile launcher
0275ddfe941e.plain: Add 2 to the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon against an AIRCRAFT unit. Attacks from this weapon allocated to an AIRCRAFT model have Damage D6+6.

036b8138439f.name: Datalink Telemetry
036b8138439f.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this unit and visible to it. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the hit roll each time a friendly <CHAPTER> WHIRLWIND model attacks the selected unit with a Blast weapon.

03c797e3096f.name: Dragonrage Bolts
03c797e3096f.plain: When you give a model this Relic, pick one bolt weapon it has. When the bearer shoots with that weapon, you can have it fire a dragonrage bolt. If you do, that weapon makes only one attack, but if that attack hits, make D6 wound rolls for it instead of one (each successful wound roll is a separate wound that must be allocated). For that attack, the target gets no benefit of cover to its saving throw, and the weapon has Damage 1 and Armour Penetration -1.

0632dae1c522.name: Frost Weapon
0632dae1c522.plain: When you give this Relic to a model, pick one weapon it has: lightning claw, master-crafted power axe, master-crafted power sword, power axe or power sword. Add 1 to that weapon's Strength and to its Damage (if the model has two lightning claws, both of them get this bonus). The chosen weapon (or both lightning claws) counts as a Chapter Relic.

066413400d38.name: Blade Stance
066413400d38.plain:
If this model is within Engagement Range of any enemy units when the Fight phase starts, choose one stance below for it to use until that phase ends:
• Defensive Parries: this model gets a 4+ invulnerable save, and you add 1 to its armour saving throws.
• Beheading Strikes: add 1 to this model's Strength, and whenever it makes a melee attack, an unmodified wound roll of 6 deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of any normal damage.
• Whirling Blade: add 1 to this model's Attacks, and it fights first this phase.

0688e47f2e87.name: Suppressing Fire
0688e47f2e87.plain: When a model in this unit attacks an enemy INFANTRY unit with an accelerator autocannon and scores a hit, that enemy unit can't fire Overwatch this turn.

07a3d22fe2fe.name: Operated Artillery
07a3d22fe2fe.plain: Enemy models can't shoot ranged weapons at a GUNNER unit while it is within 3" of its ARTILLERY unit.

08b015908188.name: Thunderhawk Cluster Bombs
08b015908188.plain: Once per battle, after the bearer has moved, if it is still on the battlefield at the end of that move, you can pick one unit it moved across. Roll six D6 for each Vehicle or Monster model in that unit and 1 D6 for each other model in that unit, up to a maximum of eighteen D6: for each 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

waive.2023: date of the dataslate that made the change, not part of the rule

0904cee565b4.name: Vow-sworn Bladesmen
0904cee565b4.plain: While any Templar Vows are active, this unit ignores that Vow's Passion.

091e4c9a8c82.name: Helios launcher
091e4c9a8c82.plain: Blast. Add 1 to the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon against an AIRCRAFT unit.

0974a62848bc.name: Terror Troops
0974a62848bc.plain:
Use in your Command phase. Pick one of your REIVER units.
• It gains the Terror Troops (Aura) ability: until your next Command phase starts, any enemy unit within 3" of it loses Objective Secured and any similar abilities that let it control an objective marker however many enemy models are in range.
• For the rest of the turn, whenever that REIVER unit finishes a Normal Move, Advance or charge move within 3" of an enemy unit performing an action, roll 2D6; if the result beats that enemy unit's Leadership characteristic, the action it is attempting fails immediately.

0996c5ac1b04.name: Grapnel Launcher
0996c5ac1b04.plain: The bearer has the Outflank ability. Whenever its unit makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, ignore any vertical distance the bearer moves when working out how far it can move this turn.

waive.125: page reference to the core rules, not part of the rule

0a5fa5d325aa.name: Tempest hammer
0a5fa5d325aa.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made with this weapon.

0ad222846989.name: Self-repair
0ad222846989.plain: When each of your turns starts, roll a D6 for this model. If you get a 6, it gets back one lost wound.

0b50bfd9e321.name: Incendiary Shells
0b50bfd9e321.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your BLACK TEMPLARS units is chosen to shoot. Until the end of the phase, attacks its models make with Astartes shotguns have a Damage characteristic of 2.

0b5afa280635.name: Storm shield
0b5afa280635.plain: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save. Also add 1 to its armour saves.

0b6ecf5094be.name: Covering Fire
0b6ecf5094be.plain: In your Shooting phase, once this unit has finished shooting, it may make a Normal Move (as though it were your Movement phase) if it contains an Eliminator Sergeant armed with an instigator bolt carbine and is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

0c285b35f5be.name: Ocular Networking
0c285b35f5be.plain: Use when one of your VANGUARD SPEARHEAD units is chosen to shoot (in your Shooting phase) or to fight (in the Fight phase). For the rest of the phase, whenever one of its models attacks a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 2 (this stacks with the bonus from the Combat Doctrines ability).

0ca0068433b6.name: Unyielding Ancient
0ca0068433b6.plain: Whenever this model loses a wound, roll a D6. If the result is 6, ignore the damage: the wound isn't lost.

0ca166b3c27c.name: Venator neutron laser
0ca166b3c27c.plain: If the bearer Remained Stationary during your last Movement phase, attacks from this weapon have Damage 6 when they are allocated to a model.

0d0fd30afbed.name: Arbiter's Gaze
0d0fd30afbed.plain:
• Whenever the bearer attacks, a hit roll of 2+ always succeeds, whatever modifiers or abilities the target has, and this includes Overwatch.
• The target gets no benefit from cover against the bearer's attacks.

0d10e36d1c81.name: Colossal Flyer
0d10e36d1c81.plain: Always measure distances to and from this model's hull.

0d15eac6ebce.name: Thunder hammer
0d15eac6ebce.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made with this weapon.

0d3352624249.name: Astartes Banner (Aura)
0d3352624249.plain: Aura: models in friendly <CHAPTER> CORE units add 1 to their Leadership while their unit is within 6" of this model. Also, whenever an enemy model's attack destroys a model in such a unit, roll one D6. On a 4+, leave the destroyed model in play: once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, the destroyed model can either fire one of its ranged weapons as though it were your Shooting phase, or make one attack with a melee weapon as though it were the Fight phase. Remove it once those attacks are resolved.

0d7a5a2b4447.name: Plasma cannon, Supercharge
0d7a5a2b4447.plain: Blast. If you roll any unmodified hit rolls of 1 for this profile's attacks, the bearer is destroyed once it has finished shooting this weapon.

0e682fcc9910.name: Death to the Traitors!
0e682fcc9910.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, that unit's models can re-roll the hit roll for their melee attacks against HERETIC ASTARTES units.

0f1f6af25615.name: Haywire Bolts
0f1f6af25615.plain: When you give a model this Relic, pick one bolt weapon it has. When the bearer shoots with that weapon, you can have it fire a haywire bolt. If you do, that weapon makes only one attack. If that attack targets a VEHICLE unit, an unmodified wound roll of 4 or 5 deals D3 mortal wounds to the target, and an unmodified wound roll of 6 deals 3 mortal wounds to it. These are on top of any other damage.

0f5119f7deba.name: Suffer Not the Unclean to Live
0f5119f7deba.plain: Use at the start of the Fight phase. Pick one of your SWORD BRETHREN units. For this phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its models, and until the end of the phase you can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made by that unit.

0fc883bcb15c.name: Transport
0fc883bcb15c.plain: This model can carry 25 <CHAPTER> INFANTRY models. Each JUMP PACK, WULFEN or TERMINATOR model counts as 2 models, and each CENTURION model counts as 3 models. It can't carry PRIMARIS models.

100c786d9f03.name: Mechadendrite
100c786d9f03.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it gets 2 extra attacks with this weapon.

1113ecfc291a.name: Spiritual Leaders (Aura)
1113ecfc291a.plain: Aura: while one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models can choose to use this model's Leadership characteristic rather than their own.

1124f5362329.name: Biker Bodyguard
1124f5362329.plain: Each time a friendly <CHAPTER> BIKER CHARACTER loses a wound while within 3" of this unit, roll a dice. On a 2+, a model from this unit intercepts the hit: the character doesn't lose the wound, but this unit suffers a mortal wound.

12a3641850cb.name: Tactical Precision
12a3641850cb.plain: While one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

13133d35ba52.name: Marksman bolt carbine
13133d35ba52.plain: An unmodified hit roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon hits automatically and also wounds automatically; don't make a wound roll for it.

13a79f408802.name: Orbital Comms Array
13a79f408802.plain: In your Command phase, a model from your army with an Orbital comms array can call in an orbital barrage, if that array hasn't been used yet in this battle. Pick a point on the battlefield, then roll one D6 for every unit within D6" of it (subtract 1 from the roll if the unit is a CHARACTER). On a 4+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3 mortal wounds.

1411313bb1d0.name: Bolt sniper rifle
1411313bb1d0.plain: This weapon can target a CHARACTER even when that CHARACTER isn't the closest enemy unit. Also, each time you attack with this weapon, pick one of its profiles.

151c9928be49.name: Volkite falconet battery
151c9928be49.plain: An unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon deals 2 mortal wounds to the target on top of any normal damage.

157d07486bb8.name: Skyreaper battery
157d07486bb8.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll for each attack made with this weapon against an AIRCRAFT unit. Each attack from this weapon allocated to an AIRCRAFT model has a Damage characteristic of 4.

160166d58c70.name: Rapid Fire
160166d58c70.plain: Use at the end of your Shooting phase. Pick one of your INTERCESSOR SQUAD or VETERAN INTERCESSOR SQUAD units; it can shoot again.

161fcdadbf2e.name: Explodes
161fcdadbf2e.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll a D6 before any embarked models disembark and before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within 3" suffers 1 mortal wound.

169450e90f41.name: Explodes
169450e90f41.plain: When this model drops to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before any embarked models disembark and before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

1774e1a50297.name: Turbo-boost
1774e1a50297.plain: When this model Advances, don't roll a dice: add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead.

18d5a9343d7d.name: Bolts of Judgement
18d5a9343d7d.plain: When you give this Relic to a model, pick one bolt weapon it has. Each time the bearer shoots with that weapon, you can choose to fire a bolt of judgement. If you do, the weapon makes only one attack, but that attack has AP -2 and Damage 3, and unless the target is a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, its wound roll always succeeds on a 2+.

1937f5ef06a3.name: Drakeblade
1937f5ef06a3.plain: An unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of the normal damage.

19d1f84c2f81.name: Wolf Priest
19d1f84c2f81.plain: This unit gains the WOLF PRIEST keyword if it belongs to the Space Wolves or to a successor Chapter of the Space Wolves.

1a7c2e918283.name: Fleshrender Grenades
1a7c2e918283.plain: Blast. The target gets no benefit from Light Cover against attacks made with this weapon.

1b6e2a1f67f0.name: Unyielding in the Face of the Foe
1b6e2a1f67f0.plain: Use in any phase, when one of your MK X GRAVIS units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, add 1 to armour saving throws against any attack with a Damage characteristic of 1 that is allocated to one of its models.

1c2b29e72abf.name: Guerilla Tactics
1c2b29e72abf.plain: Use in your Movement phase, when one of your PHOBOS units that is more than 6" from any enemy models is chosen to move. If the mission uses the Strategic Reserves rule, put that unit into Strategic Reserves. It can't arrive from Strategic Reserves in the same turn it was put there.

1c987648c0ad.name: Explodes (5+/D6+6"/D6)
1c987648c0ad.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the battlefield. On a 5+ it explodes, and every unit within D6+6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

1ef66af2627c.name: Conversion beamer
1ef66af2627c.plain: Attacks with a conversion beamer against targets more than half its range away are resolved at Strength 8, AP -1 and Damage 2.

1fdce13878ba.name: Twin Icarus rocket pod
1fdce13878ba.plain: Blast. Add 1 to the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon against an Aircraft unit.

2092c8dcc7cb.name: Bombastic Delivery
2092c8dcc7cb.plain: Use in your Command phase, when you pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CHAPLAIN units to recite a litany. One litany it recites this phase is automatically inspiring (don't roll), and it can recite one extra litany this phase.

215a5f948307.name: Master-crafted occulus bolt rifle
215a5f948307.plain: Targets of attacks made with this weapon don't get the benefit of cover to their saving throws.

218fd3ef7967.name: Master of Sanctity
218fd3ef7967.plain: This model knows one extra litany from the Litanies of Battle. In your Command phase, while this model is on the battlefield, it can recite one extra litany it knows, as long as no friendly model has already recited that litany this turn.

21f3157cd2a3.name: Twin hellstrike launcher
21f3157cd2a3.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon against an AIRCRAFT unit. Attacks from this weapon allocated to an AIRCRAFT model have Damage D3+3.

223643c76dc7.name: Armorium Cherub
223643c76dc7.plain: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, once this unit has shot, one of its models can shoot again straight away with one of its ranged weapons.

22cbe51a3666.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
22cbe51a3666.plain: Use in your Command phase. Pick one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES MACHINE SPIRIT models. Until the start of your next Command phase, it counts as having its full wounds remaining when you work out which characteristics on its profile to use.

2319a13fcfb0.name: Ironclad assault launchers
2319a13fcfb0.plain: The bearer gets the ASSAULT LAUNCHERS keyword.

23b7e91445da.name: Adamantine Mantle
23b7e91445da.plain: Roll one D6 each time the bearer of this Relic would lose a wound: if you roll 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

23d4427f9347.name: Hammer of Wrath
23d4427f9347.plain: Use in your Charge phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK units finishes a charge move. Pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, and roll one D6 for every model of that JUMP PACK unit within Engagement Range of the enemy unit. For each roll equal to or higher than the enemy unit's Toughness characteristic, it suffers 1 mortal wound.

2431c2d7e893.name: Combat Squads
2431c2d7e893.plain: At the start of the game, before any models are deployed, if this unit has its maximum number of models, you can split it into two units with an equal number of models each.

244f480e56a1.name: Sword of the High Marshals - One Handed
244f480e56a1.plain: Each attack with this profile gets 2 hit rolls instead of 1 hit roll.

24bf3266d84f.name: Command Squad
24bf3266d84f.plain: For every <CHAPTER> COMPANY VETERANS unit in a Detachment, you can include one <CHAPTER> COMMAND SQUAD COMPANY CHAMPION unit in that Detachment without it using a Battlefield Role slot.

26d92b7ac941.name: Smokescreen
26d92b7ac941.plain: As long as this unit has at least 1 Neophyte in it, it has the SMOKESCREEN keyword.

27c838fe3046.name: Heavy melta rifle
27c838fe3046.plain: Against targets within half range, this weapon's attacks have Damage D6+4.

294d9156cac2.name: Jump pack
294d9156cac2.plain: The bearer has a 12" Move characteristic, the FLY and JUMP PACK keywords, and the Death From Above ability.

29d04990ca45.name: Chapter Master
29d04990ca45.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <CHAPTER> CORE or <CHAPTER> CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, you can re-roll the hit roll for every attack its models make.

2a073c55df0a.name: Icarus Rocket Pod
2a073c55df0a.plain: Blast. Add 1 to the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon against an Aircraft unit.

2a3306ac77bf.name: Blizzard shield
2a3306ac77bf.plain: The bearer gets a 4+ invulnerable save.

2ad5b9c3b5f0.name: Explodes
2ad5b9c3b5f0.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within D6+6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

2e8d3c365118.name: Combat Restoratives
2e8d3c365118.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, pick one model from a friendly <CHAPTER> INFANTRY or <CHAPTER> BIKER unit within 3" of this model: this model heals it, and it regains up to D3 lost wounds. No model can be healed more than once per turn.

2ea2fc52348d.name: Assault Vehicle
2ea2fc52348d.plain: Units inside this transport can disembark even if the transport made a Normal Move this phase, but a unit that disembarks after it made a Normal Move can't charge this turn.

2fd7a8fb28a4.name: 2. Psalm of the Remorseless Persecution
2fd7a8fb28a4.plain: If this litany is inspiring, pick one of your BLACK TEMPLAR CORE units within 6" of this PRIEST. When a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified wound roll of 6 also inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target, on top of any normal damage. No unit can suffer more than 6 mortal wounds per phase from this ability.

2fe9b06448ff.name: Explodes (3"/1)
2fe9b06448ff.plain: Roll one D6 for this model when it is destroyed, before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 3" of it suffers 1 mortal wound.

32bb4ae253ef.name: Gatebreaker Bolts
32bb4ae253ef.plain: When you give a model this Relic, pick one bolt weapon it has. When the bearer shoots with that weapon, you can have it fire a gatebreaker bolt. If you do, that weapon makes only one attack, but if that attack hits, make D3 wound rolls for it instead of one (each successful wound roll is a separate wound that must be allocated). For that attack, the weapon has Armour Penetration -5 and Damage 1.

338b50764ce0.name: Epitome of Piety
338b50764ce0.plain:
• This Warlord can try to deny one psychic power in your opponent's Psychic phase, just as a Psyker could.
• Add 1 to this Warlord's Deny the Witch tests.

3404b226e0ec.name: Command Authority
3404b226e0ec.plain: Each time your Command phase starts with this model on the battlefield, roll a D6: you get 1 command point on a 5+.

347b1cbd9397.name: Unstoppable Fury
347b1cbd9397.plain: If this model has two Dreadnought close combat weapons, add 1 to its Attacks characteristic.

35b9326c4eab.name: Devout
35b9326c4eab.plain: This unit can try to deny one psychic power in your opponent's Psychic phase, just as a PSYKER could.

35fc9b87adec.name: Explodes
35fc9b87adec.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within 6" suffers 1 mortal wound.

37573d2e4943.name: Deeds of Heroism (Aura)
37573d2e4943.plain: Aura: friendly <CHAPTER> BLADEGUARD units within 6" of this model add 1 to the hit roll of every attack their models make.

381103ebd1cb.name: Hunter-slayer missile
381103ebd1cb.plain: The bearer can shoot each hunter-slayer missile it has only once per battle. This weapon can target units the bearer can't see.

38ca25a779b5.name: Seal of Oath
38ca25a779b5.plain: Before the first turn begins, at the start of the first battle round, pick one enemy unit. From then until the battle ends, the bearer has this Aura ability (Seal of Oath): while one of your Ultramarines Core or Ultramarines Character units is within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll for attacks its models make against the enemy unit you picked.

38e1cd77c812.name: Transhuman Physiology
38e1cd77c812.plain: Use in any phase, when one of your PRIMARIS units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, each unmodified wound roll of 1-3 for an attack against that unit fails, whatever abilities the weapon or attacking model has. This Stratagem costs 1CP if that unit has 5 or fewer models, and 2CP otherwise.

390281659351.name: Camo Cloak
390281659351.plain: While the bearer is receiving the benefits of cover, its armour saving throws against ranged attacks allocated to it get an extra 1 added.

3949707a015b.name: Uncompromising Fire
3949707a015b.plain: Use in your Shooting phase. Pick one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units that is performing an action. It can shoot this phase and its action doesn't fail.

394ff17c0156.name: Only in Death Does Duty End
394ff17c0156.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER models is destroyed before it has been chosen to fight this phase. Don't remove it yet: it can fight once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks. Remove it after its own attacks are resolved.

3ac16341296f.name: Haywire Mine
3ac16341296f.plain: Once per battle, when an enemy unit ends a charge move within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit, you can set off the bearer's Haywire mine: roll one D6, and on a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (3 mortal wounds instead if it is a VEHICLE).

3b0058b662cd.name: Neo-volkite pistol
3b0058b662cd.plain: An unmodified wound roll of 6 with this weapon inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target as well as any other damage.

3bef223ea229.name: Devastating Charge
3bef223ea229.plain: If this unit made a charge move this turn, then each time it fights, add 2 to the Attacks of its models until that fight is resolved.

3de2ff07b127.name: Indomitus Crusaders
3de2ff07b127.plain: Use when choosing your army. Pick one Space Marines Detachment in your army to be an Indomitus Crusaders Specialist Detachment. In that Detachment, these units gain the INDOMITUS CRUSADER keyword: INCEPTOR SQUADS, INTERCESSOR SQUADS, PRIMARIS ANCIENTS, PRIMARIS LIEUTENANTS and PRIMARIS CAPTAINS.

3de7118295f2.name: Assault Launchers
3de7118295f2.plain:
Use at the start of your Charge phase. Pick one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES ASSAULT LAUNCHERS units and one enemy unit within 9" of it (excluding VEHICLE or MONSTER units). That enemy unit can either brace or duck for cover:
• If it braces, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
• If it ducks for cover, then until the end of the turn its models get 1 subtracted from their Attacks characteristic, and it can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend.

3e8909902cc7.name: Hellfire Shells
3e8909902cc7.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY models shoots with a heavy bolter, hellstorm heavy bolter or executor heavy bolter. That weapon makes only one attack this phase, but if it hits, the target suffers D3 mortal wounds (3 mortal wounds instead if it is a MONSTER unit) and the attack sequence ends.

3f794f49ca3b.name: Twin Terrax volkite charger
3f794f49ca3b.plain: Each unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target as well as its normal damage.

410e74604609.name: Explodes (6"/D3)
410e74604609.plain: Roll one D6 for this model when it is destroyed, before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 6" of it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

411fc639cf24.name: Reiver grav-chute
411fc639cf24.plain: The bearer gains the Death From Above ability.

41fbce66fce0.name: 1. Litany of Divine Protection
41fbce66fce0.plain: If this litany is inspiring, pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE or BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER units within 6" of this Priest. Roll one D6 whenever one of that unit's models would lose a wound: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

4211287ed0ba.name: Melta rifle
4211287ed0ba.plain: Against targets within half range, this weapon's attacks have Damage D6+2.

4219aa80d472.name: Pivotal Moment
4219aa80d472.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your VANGUARD SPEARHEAD CORE models is chosen to shoot. For the rest of the phase, whenever it makes a ranged attack against an enemy WARLORD and the wound roll succeeds, the target suffers mortal wounds equal to the weapon's Damage characteristic, and the attack sequence ends.

439fdb4ed730.name: Spiritual Leaders
439fdb4ed730.plain: While one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models can choose to use this model's Leadership characteristic rather than their own.

43e156af04fb.name: Superlative Duellist
43e156af04fb.plain: When this model makes an attack with a melee weapon against a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll.

4408341c9b01.name: Hellstrike missile battery
4408341c9b01.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll for each attack made with this weapon against an AIRCRAFT unit. Each attack from this weapon allocated to an AIRCRAFT model has a Damage characteristic of D3+3.

458775a70a48.name: Warden's Cuirass
458775a70a48.plain: A model with this Relic has 1 added to its Wounds characteristic.

45a56137baad.name: Auric Aquila
45a56137baad.plain: The bearer of this Relic has a 4+ invulnerable save. Also, roll one D6 each time it would lose a wound to a mortal wound in the Psychic phase: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

45b96d413c66.name: Armour of Fate
45b96d413c66.plain: This model's invulnerable save is 3+. The first time it is destroyed, roll one D6 when the phase ends: on a 4+, put it back on the battlefield as near as possible to where it was destroyed, not within Engagement Range of any enemy models, with D6 wounds left.

45ff3afc4021.name: Exemplars of the Crusade
45ff3afc4021.plain: Use in the Fight phase. Pick one of your SWORD BRETHREN units. Until the end of the phase, each unmodified hit roll of 6 for a melee attack made by a model in that unit scores 1 extra hit.

467f731dcdcd.name: Command Uplink (Aura)
467f731dcdcd.plain: Aura: while one of your units is within 6" of this model, it always counts as being within range of the Rites of Battle and Tactical Precision aura abilities of any friendly <CHAPTER> units on the battlefield.

47d090417cdb.name: Explodes
47d090417cdb.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within 6" suffers 1 mortal wound.

47eee01764ce.name: Tarantula air defence missiles
47eee01764ce.plain: Blast. Against an AIRCRAFT unit, this weapon's attacks have Damage 2.

48ec73666c99.name: Outflank
48ec73666c99.plain: During deployment, if every model in this unit has this ability, you can set the unit up behind enemy lines rather than on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up during the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases, wholly within 6" of any battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy models.

49163aba8ac6.name: Angels of Death
49163aba8ac6.plain: This unit has And They Shall Know No Fear, Bolter Discipline, Shock Assault and Combat Doctrines (described below).

49bbb50d9a2c.name: Hammerfall heavy flamer array
49bbb50d9a2c.plain: Attacks made with this weapon automatically hit the target.

4b994c689c53.name: Righteous Zeal
4b994c689c53.plain:
• Units with this tactic can re-roll their Advance and charge rolls.
• Whenever a mortal wound would make a model with this tactic lose a wound, roll one D6; on a 5+, the wound is not lost.

4b9bf8887ad5.name: Voxbreaker Auspex
4b9bf8887ad5.plain:
Use in your Command phase. Pick one enemy unit within 18" of one of your VOXBREAKER AUSPEX units. Until the start of your next turn:
• Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each ranged attack made by a model in that enemy unit.
• If that enemy unit declares a charge, you can pick one of your units targeted by that charge; that unit can Hold Steady or Set to Defend.

4c60f1449bc9.name: Liberators
4c60f1449bc9.plain: Use when the Fight phase starts. Pick one of your INDOMITUS CRUSADER units. Until your next turn starts, whenever a model in this unit rolls an unmodified 6 to hit, that attack scores 2 hits on the target rather than 1.

4cbab179fcb6.name: Contemptor plasma blaster, Supercharge
4cbab179fcb6.plain: For every unmodified hit roll of 1 made for this profile's attacks, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting.

4d375afd8b93.name: Defensive Array
4d375afd8b93.plain: In your Shooting phase, each time this model is chosen to shoot, its Deathstorm cannon array or its Deathstorm missile array can target, and make attacks against, every eligible enemy unit. When this model fires Overwatch, it only makes attacks with its weapons against the charging unit, but its Deathstorm cannon array becomes Heavy 12 and its Deathstorm missile array becomes Heavy 4 for that.

4dd5363a6a4b.name: The Emperor's Shield
4dd5363a6a4b.plain:
This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.
Each time you roll an unmodified 6 on a saving throw for this model against a melee attack, the attacking model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound once all of its models have finished their attacks (no more than 3 mortal wounds each phase).

4e8b3e5cf687.name: Vicious Riposte
4e8b3e5cf687.plain: Use at the start of the Fight phase. Pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE units. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in it is destroyed by a melee attack and doesn't explode, roll one D6: on a 5+, the attacking model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished its attacks (no unit can suffer more than 6 mortal wounds per phase from this).

4e95a4938913.name: Litanies of Battle
4e95a4938913.plain: This model knows the Litany of Hate, plus one litany from the Litanies of Battle. When your Command phase starts, it can recite one of its litanies, provided no friendly model has recited that litany yet this battle round. Roll one D6. If you get 3+, the litany is inspiring, and its effect lasts until your next Command phase.

waive.188: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

5017f96f705b.name: Crewed Artillery
5017f96f705b.plain: Once this unit has been set up on the battlefield for the first time, split it into two units: one with the ARTILLERY model and one with the GUNNER model. If the GUNNER unit isn't within 3" of its ARTILLERY unit at the end of any phase, that ARTILLERY unit is destroyed.

512bb9f126e5.name: Fury of the First
512bb9f126e5.plain: Use when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units is chosen to shoot (in your Shooting phase) or chosen to fight (in the Fight phase). Until the end of that phase, add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made by a TERMINATOR model in that unit.

52b419ab3b38.name: Sword of the High Marshals
52b419ab3b38.plain: Each time you make an attack with this weapon, choose one of the profiles below for that attack.

52ef957550d5.name: Honour the Chapter
52ef957550d5.plain: Use at the end of the Fight phase. Pick one of your ASSAULT INTERCESSOR SQUAD units that is within Engagement Range of any enemy units; it can fight again.

5323b5390fc8.name: Explodes
5323b5390fc8.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within 2D6" suffers 2D6 mortal wounds.

532dfd768871.name: Drop Pod Assault
532dfd768871.plain: This transport must begin the battle up in the skies (see Death From Above), but it and any units inside it don't count towards any mission limit on the number of Reinforcement units in your army. Whatever the mission rules say, it can arrive in your first, second or third Movement phase, during the Reinforcements step. Once it is on the battlefield, every unit inside must disembark straight away and be placed more than 9" away from any enemy models. After that, no units can embark within it.

538d31a401f4.name: 3. Exhortation of Rage
538d31a401f4.plain: If this litany is inspiring, pick one of your CORE or CHARACTER units within 6" of this PRIEST. Add 1 to the wound roll for every melee attack made by a model in that unit.

5436efe57347.name: Frontline Commander
5436efe57347.plain:
• Add 1 to this Warlord's Advance rolls and charge rolls.
• When one of your BLACK TEMPLAR CORE units declares a charge that targets an enemy unit within Engagement Range of this Warlord, that unit adds 1 to its charge roll.

54f428e36105.name: Sword Brethren
54f428e36105.plain: Use when choosing your army. Pick one BLACK TEMPLARS Detachment in your army to be a Sword Brethren Specialist Detachment. In that Detachment, these units gain the SWORD BRETHREN keyword: COMPANY VETERANS, COMPANY CHAMPIONS, CAPTAINS, EMPEROR'S CHAMPION and HIGH MARSHAL HELBRECHT.

5575c3359678.name: Death Visions
5575c3359678.plain: Once per battle, when this model is chosen to fight, it can use one of the Death Visions below. Each Death Vision can only be used once per battle.

55c31c9fad47.name: Primarch of the First Legion (Aura)
55c31c9fad47.plain: Aura: while one of your DARK ANGELS CORE or DARK ANGELS CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, attacks made by models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

561362f5f061.name: Quad launcher, Thunderfire shells
561362f5f061.plain: Blast. This weapon can target units the firing model can't see.

564bb73f5b05.name: Promethean Plate
564bb73f5b05.plain: Any attack against the bearer of this Relic always fails to wound on an unmodified wound roll of 1, 2 or 3, whatever abilities the attacker or its weapon have.

57384aeea435.name: Vow-sworn Bladesman
57384aeea435.plain: While any Templar Vows are active, this unit ignores that Vow's Passion.

57483fb55604.name: Cyber-Eagle Helm
57483fb55604.plain: When a model in one of your <CHAPTER> units within 6" of a model from your army with this Relic makes an Overwatch attack, it hits on a hit roll of 5 or 6.

586428a25d85.name: Rites of Battle
586428a25d85.plain: While one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

58b52b56ac1b.name: Tenacious Assault
58b52b56ac1b.plain: Use when an enemy INFANTRY or BEAST unit that can't FLY is selected to Fall Back while it is within Engagement Range of one or more BLACK TEMPLARS units from your army. Roll one D6; on a 4+, the enemy unit isn't allowed to Fall Back.

59529cd5881b.name: Automated Emplacement
59529cd5881b.plain: Each time a model in this unit shoots, first pick one of these keywords: INFANTRY or VEHICLE. Until those shots are resolved, that model's attacks must target the closest eligible enemy unit with the chosen keyword; if no eligible unit has either keyword, it must target the closest eligible unit. This unit can never be eligible to charge or perform a Heroic Intervention, and it can't make pile-in or consolidation moves.

5a92a1bd893e.name: Teleport Strike
5a92a1bd893e.plain: During deployment, you can place this model in a teleportarium chamber rather than on the battlefield. It can then teleport in when any of your Movement phases ends: put it anywhere on the battlefield over 9" from every enemy model.

5b6147b91f2c.name: Heir of Sigismund
5b6147b91f2c.plain: Use after you choose a BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER model that isn't a named character as your WARLORD; you can only use it once. Give that model one extra Warlord Trait, which must come from the Black Templars Warlord Traits table. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you roll randomly).

5c106596ce3e.name: Master-Crafted Weapon
5c106596ce3e.plain: When you give a model this Relic, pick one weapon it is equipped with (not a weapon whose profile includes the word 'master-crafted'). Add 1 to that weapon's Damage characteristic. That weapon counts as a Chapter Relic.

5ecf726efc84.name: Litany of Hate (Aura)
5ecf726efc84.plain: If this litany is inspiring, then while one of your Core or Character units is within 6" of this Priest, you can re-roll the hit roll for each melee attack made by a model in that unit.

5ed70c734dde.name: Power Overload
5ed70c734dde.plain: If you roll three or more hit rolls of 1 in the same phase for this model's lascannons or twin lascannons, it suffers a power overload and takes 6 mortal wounds.

60181812590c.name: Servo-skull Hub
60181812590c.plain:
In each of your Shooting phases, pick one of these effects:
• Targeting Data Skull: until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls made for one of your CHAPTER units within 12" of this model.
• Repair Skull: pick one CHAPTER VEHICLE within 12" of this model; it regains 1 lost wound.
• Vox Skull: until your next Shooting phase, subtract 1 from Morale tests taken for your CHAPTER units within 12" of this model.

60289827435f.name: Occulus bolt carbine
60289827435f.plain: The target gets no benefit from cover against attacks made with this weapon.

6041544080e9.name: Hover Jet
6041544080e9.plain: In your Movement phase, before this model moves, you can say it is hovering. If you do, its Move characteristic is 20" until the end of that phase, and it loses the Airborne, Hard to Hit and Supersonic abilities until the start of your next Movement phase.

60dec2580867.name: Combat shield
60dec2580867.plain: Models equipped with a combat shield get a 5+ invulnerable save.

6105540cdc61.name: Hard to Hit
6105540cdc61.plain: In the Shooting phase, your opponent subtracts 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this model.

611bce413fdd.name: Thunderfire Cannon
611bce413fdd.plain: Blast. This weapon can target units the firing model can't see.

62863cfc1bae.name: Grav Pulse
62863cfc1bae.plain:
Use in one of these two situations:
• In your Movement phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES REPULSOR FIELD units Falls Back: it can still shoot this turn even though it Fell Back.
• In your opponent's Charge phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES REPULSOR FIELD units is chosen as a charge target: for the rest of the phase, every unit that declares a charge targeting that REPULSOR FIELD unit subtracts 2 from its charge rolls.

636fcb14f06f.name: Inner Circle
636fcb14f06f.plain:
This applies if the unit has the Grim Resolve Chapter Tactic, or if it has the Inheritors of the Primarch Successor tactic and uses the Dark Angels Chapter Tactic:
• It passes Morale tests automatically.
• Unless it has the VEHICLE keyword, it can't be selected to Fall Back while it is within Engagement Range of any enemy FALLEN units.
• Whenever you want it to Fall Back, roll 2D6 unless it has the VEHICLE, RAVENWING or CHAPTER MASTER keyword: if the total is no higher than its Leadership characteristic, it can Fall Back; if not, it can't, and it must Remain Stationary instead.

639e4b737ae4.name: Fist of Terra
639e4b737ae4.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 1 extra attack with this weapon.

646b13fcc27a.name: Chapter Banner
646b13fcc27a.plain: In your Command phase, choose one <CHAPTER> CORE unit within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase begins, that unit's models add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack they make.

646c806ccb33.name: Cyclonic melta lance
646c806ccb33.plain: Blast. Against targets within half range, this weapon's attacks have Damage D6+2.

64b29752277a.name: Hellfury Bolts
64b29752277a.plain: When you give a model this Relic, pick one bolt weapon it has. When the bearer shoots with that weapon, you can have it fire a hellfury bolt. If you do, that weapon makes only one attack, but if that attack hits, the target suffers 1 mortal wound and the attack sequence ends.

6545efa358e8.name: Martial Exemplar
6545efa358e8.plain: This model can fight first in the Fight phase if, when that phase starts, it is within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

68ee16907a2b.name: Whirlwind Hyperios launcher
68ee16907a2b.plain: Blast. This weapon can target units the bearer can't see. Add 2 to the hit roll for attacks made with it against an AIRCRAFT unit, and attacks from it allocated to an AIRCRAFT model have Damage 2.

691aa9f84009.name: Shadowmaster Cloak
691aa9f84009.plain: While a model with this Relic is wholly on or in a terrain feature, it has a 3+ invulnerable save.

693cbada240f.name: Rites of Rage (Aura)
693cbada240f.plain: Aura: while one of your DEATH COMPANY CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

69f973ece936.name: Dispersal Protocols
69f973ece936.plain: Use when the Fight phase ends. Pick one of your VANGUARD SPEARHEAD units that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. That unit can Fall Back as though it were your Movement phase.

6b04d92f5e6e.name: Bolt sniper rifle - Mortis round
6b04d92f5e6e.plain: You can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when picking targets for this weapon. For attacks made with it, a wound roll of 6+ deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of any other damage.

6beb95732fb2.name: Infiltrator comms array
6beb95732fb2.plain: The bearer's unit always counts as being in range of the Rites of Battle and Tactical Precision aura abilities of any friendly <CHAPTER> PHOBOS units on the battlefield.

6c103fffaace.name: Icarus Ironhail Heavy Stubber
6c103fffaace.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon against an AIRCRAFT unit.

6cd91b2adfdc.name: Executioner Relic Blade
6cd91b2adfdc.plain: An unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of any other damage.

6ddc571b09d8.name: Instigator Bolt Carbine
6ddc571b09d8.plain: You can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when picking targets for this weapon.

6f8ce958758e.name: Explodes (D6+6"/2D6)
6f8ce958758e.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within D6+6" suffers 2D6 mortal wounds.

6fac7e41de8a.name: For the Emperor’s Honour!
6fac7e41de8a.plain: Use in the Fight phase. Pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER units (excluding VEHICLE units) and one enemy CHARACTER unit. For the rest of the phase, whenever that enemy CHARACTER unit is chosen to fight, if your chosen BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER unit is within Engagement Range of it when your opponent picks targets, its attacks can only target your chosen BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER unit.

70d730feedeb.name: Servo-arm
70d730feedeb.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it can make no more than one attack with each servo-arm.

72171519a0c8.name: Ravenwing
72171519a0c8.plain: This unit gains the RAVENWING keyword if it belongs to the Dark Angels or to a successor Chapter of the Dark Angels.

729d949e8dd5.name: Narthecium
729d949e8dd5.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, you can pick one friendly <CHAPTER> INFANTRY or <CHAPTER> BIKER unit within 3" of this model to receive its medical attention. If a model in that unit is missing wounds, it regains up to D3 of them. If not, and models from that unit have been destroyed, roll one D6: on a 4+, you may put one destroyed model from that unit back on the battlefield with 1 wound left, within 3" of this model and in unit coherency (if it can't be placed like that, it doesn't come back). On a 3 or less, this model may not shoot, charge or fight this turn. A unit can only receive medical attention once per turn.

72bb925b7a38.name: Martial Legacy
72bb925b7a38.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, including this unit in a Detachment increases that Detachment's Command Cost by 1 CP.

72bfaefc7999.name: Headtaker's Trophies
72bfaefc7999.plain: While an enemy unit is within 6" of a model from your army that has this Relic, subtract 1 from that enemy unit's Leadership characteristic.

73d635a2346b.name: Tactical Aggression (Aura)
73d635a2346b.plain: Aura: while one of your DEATH COMPANY CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

74bcd1102409.name: Swiftclaw
74bcd1102409.plain: If this unit belongs to the Space Wolves Chapter or one of its successors, it gains the SWIFTCLAW keyword.

758e646b4695.name: Rites of Battle (Aura)
758e646b4695.plain: Aura: while one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

75b597e93175.name: Orbital Comms Array
75b597e93175.plain: In your Shooting phase, you can choose one model in your army whose Orbital Comms Array hasn't been used yet this battle. It uses the array to call in an orbital barrage: choose a point on the battlefield, then roll a D6 for every unit within D6" of it, subtracting 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER unit. On a 4+, the unit rolled for suffers D3 mortal wounds.

75de5acb4639.name: Command Squad
75de5acb4639.plain: For every <CHAPTER> COMPANY VETERANS unit in a Detachment, you can include one <CHAPTER> COMMAND SQUAD COMPANY ANCIENT unit in that Detachment without it using a Battlefield Role slot.

75f9ad1157f3.name: Melta destroyer
75f9ad1157f3.plain: Against targets within half range, this weapon's attacks have Damage D6+2.

762170054d95.name: Plasma eradicator, Supercharge
762170054d95.plain: Blast. After shooting with this weapon profile, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound for each unmodified hit roll of 1 made for its attacks.

766f414688e5.name: Brutalis Talon - Strike
766f414688e5.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll for attacks made with this profile.

771bd12bca13.name: Explodes (2D6"/2D6)
771bd12bca13.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within 2D6" suffers 2D6 mortal wounds.

781882c09270.name: Drop Pod Assault
781882c09270.plain: This transport has to begin the battle set up high in the skies (using Death From Above), but neither it nor any units embarked in it count towards any limit your mission sets on how many Reinforcements units your army can have. It can arrive during the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, whatever the mission rules say, and it must be set up more than 9" from any enemy models. Once it has been set up on the battlefield, no units can embark in it.

waive.125: page reference to the core rules, not part of the rule

788b9b88fc10.name: Teeth of Mars
788b9b88fc10.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 1 extra attack with this weapon. When an attack with this weapon is made against a VEHICLE unit, this weapon has Strength x2 for that attack.

78a7d772d4e0.name: Deeds of Heroism [Aura]
78a7d772d4e0.plain: Aura: while their unit is within 6" of this model, friendly <CHAPTER> BLADEGUARD models add 1 to their hit rolls.

7bc6f678d671.name: XIII Primarch (Aura)
7bc6f678d671.plain: Aura: while one of your ULTRAMARINES CORE or ULTRAMARINES CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, its models can re-roll hit rolls for their attacks. While one of your ULTRAMARINES CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models also re-roll wound rolls of 1 for their attacks.

7c2b0d967429.name: Mindlock
7c2b0d967429.plain: Models in this unit have Weapon Skill 4+, Ballistic Skill 4+ and Leadership 9 while the unit is within 6" of any friendly <CHAPTER> TECHMARINE units. Also, in a Battle-forged army, each <CHAPTER> TECHMARINE unit in a Detachment lets you add one <CHAPTER> SERVITORS unit to that Detachment that doesn't use up a Battlefield Role slot.

7d496a65b5ab.name: Sceptre of Anointing
7d496a65b5ab.plain: Add 1 to the roll that decides whether a litany recited by Chaplain Grimaldus in this unit is inspiring.

7d5e03648213.name: Hover Tank
7d5e03648213.plain: Measure distances and ranges to and from this model's hull, not its base.

7e6f15b30218.name: Twin Volkite calivers
7e6f15b30218.plain: An unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of any normal damage.

7fc2b7fabdf2.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
7fc2b7fabdf2.plain: This model ignores the hit roll penalty for moving and shooting Heavy weapons.

7fea0f0653a6.name: Explodes (6"/D6)
7fea0f0653a6.plain: Roll one D6 for this model when it is destroyed, before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 6" of it suffers D6 mortal wounds.

8006f7bbb46e.name: Deadly Cargo
8006f7bbb46e.plain: Use in your Movement phase. Pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS LAND RAIDER CRUSADER models that made a Normal Move this phase. Units embarked within that TRANSPORT can disembark this phase, but can't be chosen to move again this phase.

81564dcef130.name: Angels of Death
81564dcef130.plain: This unit gets Combat Doctrines, Shock Assault, Bolter Discipline and And They Shall Know No Fear.

81f875c18375.name: Data Augurs
81f875c18375.plain: Add 1 to this model's hit rolls for shooting attacks while it is within 24" of any of your CHAPTER Rhino Primaris.

82d9e7612780.name: Multi-Spectrum Array
82d9e7612780.plain: For ranged attacks made by this unit's models, you may disregard some or all hit roll modifiers and Ballistic Skill modifiers.

830d6e3086a1.name: Astartes Banner [Aura]
830d6e3086a1.plain: Aura: models in friendly <CHAPTER> CORE units add 1 to their Leadership while their unit is within 6" of this model. Also, whenever an enemy model's attack destroys a model in such a unit, roll one D6. On a 4+, leave the destroyed model in play: once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, the destroyed model can either fire one of its ranged weapons as though it were your Shooting phase, or make one attack with a melee weapon as though it were the Fight phase. Remove it once those attacks are resolved.

840e278eee07.name: Leviathan siege claw
840e278eee07.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 1 extra attack with this weapon.

846a2d44c0cd.name: Auspex Scan
846a2d44c0cd.plain: Use in your opponent's Movement phase, at the end of its Reinforcements step. Pick one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units that isn't within Engagement Range of any enemy units. It can shoot as though it were your Shooting phase, but only at a single eligible enemy unit within 12" of it that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.

8474d39b4ac2.name: Pyre Pistol
8474d39b4ac2.plain: Attacks made with this weapon always hit the target automatically.

863472cb5df8.name: Banner of Fallen Crusaders
863472cb5df8.plain: The bearer has this Aura ability (Banner of Fallen Crusaders): while one of your BLACK TEMPLAR CORE or BLACK TEMPLAR CHARACTER units is within 6" of this unit, each time you make an Advance roll for that unit, add D3+3" to its Move characteristic instead of D6".

86599a5e6ff1.name: Dreadnought Transport
86599a5e6ff1.plain: If your army is Battle-forged: for each DREADNOUGHT model with a Wounds characteristic of 9 or less in a Detachment, you can add 1 DREADNOUGHT DROP POD model to that Detachment, and it doesn't use up an extra Battlefield Role slot. You can't take more than 1 DREADNOUGHT DROP POD model per such DREADNOUGHT model.

869e6100b307.name: Hit-and-run Warfare
869e6100b307.plain: Use in your Movement phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES BIKER, LAND SPEEDER or STORM SPEEDER units Falls Back. It can still shoot this turn even though it Fell Back.

86ee6c3e6242.name: Silentus Pistol
86ee6c3e6242.plain: When choosing targets for this weapon, the Look Out, Sir rule can be ignored. Attacks with it may also add 1 to their hit rolls.

87c839d1cec5.name: Laser volley cannon, Overcharge fire
87c839d1cec5.plain: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 made for this profile's attacks, if the bearer didn't Remain Stationary in your previous Movement phase, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting this weapon.

894d7f976917.name: Hero of the Chapter
894d7f976917.plain: Use before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the ADEPTUS ASTARTES keyword. Pick one ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER model from your army that isn't a named character and give it one Warlord Trait it is allowed to have; that model only counts as your WARLORD for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you roll randomly), and you can't use this Stratagem to give one model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

8a35f1deafbc.name: Duty Eternal
8a35f1deafbc.plain: Each time an attack is allocated to this model, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

8d8e9b941094.name: Forge bolter
8d8e9b941094.plain: Even if the bearer also attacks with Pistols or Grenades when it shoots, it can still attack with this weapon.

8d96fd7b74cc.name: Suppression Fire
8d96fd7b74cc.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your WHIRLWIND models is chosen to shoot. Until the end of the phase, each time it hits with an attack from a weapon with the Blast ability, then until the start of your next turn the target can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend, and can't be chosen to fight until all eligible units from your army have fought.

8dbb13ed13a7.name: Chapter Command
8dbb13ed13a7.plain: If this model is upgraded to a Chapter Champion (see Chapter Command), it has Attacks 6 and Leadership 9.

8e1554aba2bd.name: Command Squad
8e1554aba2bd.plain: For every <CHAPTER> COMPANY VETERANS unit in a Detachment, you can include one <CHAPTER> COMMAND SQUAD APOTHECARY unit in that Detachment without it using a Battlefield Role slot.

8ebb6dd1c682.name: Gravis Fighting Style
8ebb6dd1c682.plain:
Each time the bearer fights:
• if this model has an Astartes Chainsword, it can make 2 extra attacks with it (for a maximum of 3).
• if it has a Power Sword, it can make 2 extra attacks with it.
• if it has a Power Fist, it can make 1 extra attack with it.
You can't use this ability with a Relic that replaces any of these weapons.

8ed3fce13061.name: Forestwalk
8ed3fce13061.plain: When you deploy, you can place this model on shadowed paths rather than on the battlefield. If you do, then in one of your Movement phases, during the Reinforcements step, you can set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from any enemy models; charge rolls for this model can be re-rolled until the end of that turn.

8f22251e80cc.name: Concealed Positions
8f22251e80cc.plain: When you set this unit up during Deployment, if all its models have this ability, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield over 9" from the enemy deployment zone and from every enemy model.

8fc16340e364.name: Author of the Codex
8fc16340e364.plain: If your army is Battle-forged and Roboute Guilliman is your Warlord, you get 3 extra Command Points.

90239f4abceb.name: Martial Legacy
90239f4abceb.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, including this unit in a Detachment increases that Detachment's Command Cost by 1 CP.

92bb9a54348b.name: Brutalis Talon - Sweep
92bb9a54348b.plain: For each attack made with this profile, make 2 hit rolls rather than 1.

937431be4fe3.name: Crusade of Wrath (Aura)
937431be4fe3.plain: Aura: while one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models get 1 added to their Strength characteristic.

93e774243e78.name: Runic Weapon
93e774243e78.plain:
• Add 1 to Deny the Witch tests taken for the bearer.
• When you give a model this Relic, pick one of these weapons it has: force axe, force stave or force sword. Add 1 to that weapon's Strength characteristic. That weapon counts as a Chapter Relic.

94125b1fbf08.name: Smokescreen
94125b1fbf08.plain: Use in your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES SMOKESCREEN units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made against that unit.

9475f1139e71.name: Fire Points
9475f1139e71.plain: In your Shooting phase, you can select embarked models to shoot: as many as 15 from inside the TACTICUS BUNKER model, and as many as 10 from inside each BUNKER ANNEX model. Measure their distances and line of sight from any point on that model. These embarked models can shoot even while the Building is within Engagement Range of enemy units.

94fce1f4dc75.name: Helix gauntlet
94fce1f4dc75.plain: Once per turn, the first time the bearer's unit fails a saving throw, that attack's Damage becomes 0.

951310c243e0.name: Tactical Resource
951310c243e0.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each Detachment in your army can include only one Damocles Command Rhino model.

955726d8bd3f.name: Auto launchers
955726d8bd3f.plain: The bearer gets the SMOKESCREEN keyword.

95d75c5fbd23.name: Rites of Battle
95d75c5fbd23.plain: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for your CHAPTER units within 6" of this model.

95da8c839c8c.name: Fortis-Pattern Data Spike
95da8c839c8c.plain: TECHMARINE only. When a model with this Relic uses its Blessing of the Omnissiah ability, roll two dice for the number of lost wounds regained and discard one of them.

95fe2356e239.name: Decimator Protocols
95fe2356e239.plain: Models in this unit don't take the hit roll penalty for moving and shooting Heavy weapons.

9644fb6a02a0.name: Fenrisian great axe (Cleave)
9644fb6a02a0.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll for each attack made with this profile.

96bede264888.name: Plasma gun, Supercharged
96bede264888.plain: Once this weapon has finished shooting, its bearer suffers 1 mortal wound for every roll of 1 made for its attacks.

984b3eab0b22.name: Hover Jet
984b3eab0b22.plain: You can declare that this model will hover before it moves in your Movement phase. If you do, it has a Move characteristic of 20" for the rest of the phase, and it loses its Airborne, Hard to Hit and Supersonic abilities until your next Movement phase begins.

9962da5bfc0a.name: Artificer Armour
9962da5bfc0a.plain: A model with this Relic has a 2+ Save characteristic and a 5+ invulnerable save.

997903911c52.name: Camo cloak
997903911c52.plain: If a model in this unit is receiving the benefits of cover when a ranged attack is allocated to it, add an additional 1 to the armour save made against that attack.

9a9fe7ace2b1.name: Astartes Banner
9a9fe7ace2b1.plain: <CHAPTER> units within 6" of any friendly <CHAPTER> ANCIENTS add 1 to their Leadership. Each time a <CHAPTER> INFANTRY or <CHAPTER> BIKER model is destroyed while within 6" of any friendly ANCIENTS, roll one D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 4+, it can either fire one of its ranged weapons as though it were your Shooting phase, or make one attack with a melee weapon as though it were the Fight phase.

9ad64ec23ebc.name: Defensive Array
9ad64ec23ebc.plain: When this model shoots in your Shooting phase, either the Hammerfall heavy bolter array or the Hammerfall heavy flamer array can target every eligible enemy unit and resolve attacks against all of them. When this model fires Overwatch, its weapons only resolve attacks against the charging unit, but while it does, the Hammerfall heavy bolter array's Type changes to Heavy 6 and the Hammerfall heavy flamer array's Type changes to 2D6.

9b1b6c0e3aef.name: Castellan Launcher
9b1b6c0e3aef.plain: Blast. This weapon can target units the bearer can't see.

9c5888cad250.name: Blade Parry
9c5888cad250.plain: Against melee weapons, this model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

9ce452827e24.name: Castellum air defence missiles
9ce452827e24.plain: Add 2 to the hit roll for each attack made with this weapon against an AIRCRAFT unit.

9d938a2499a4.name: Supersonic
9d938a2499a4.plain: Every time this model moves, start by pivoting it on the spot up to 90° (this pivot is free and doesn't use up any of its move), then move it straight forwards. After that first pivot it can't pivot again. When it Advances, don't roll a dice: instead add 20" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

9dda1bd554de.name: Omniscope
9dda1bd554de.plain: If this unit includes a Centurion Sergeant, the target of each ranged attack made by a model in this unit gets no benefit from cover against that attack.

9dfcc7b0194f.name: Holy Wargear
9dfcc7b0194f.plain: This model can't ever be given Relics.

9e6a92aa77ef.name: Indomitable Resolve
9e6a92aa77ef.plain: Once per battle, when Chaplain Grimaldus in this unit is destroyed, you can choose not to use any rules triggered by his destruction (such as the Only in Death Does Duty End Stratagem) and roll one D6 once the phase ends instead. If you do, on a 4+ put Chaplain Grimaldus back on the battlefield with 3 wounds left, as near as he can be to the place he was destroyed and outside Engagement Range of every enemy unit.

9fe8b2f302f9.name: Marksman Target-tracker
9fe8b2f302f9.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your MARKSMAN TARGET-TRACKER units is chosen to shoot. Until the end of the phase, whenever you pick a target for an occulus bolt carbine that a model in that unit has, you can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule.

a008e3cbb966.name: Omni-scramblers
a008e3cbb966.plain: No enemy unit arriving as reinforcements can be placed within 12" of this unit.

a090158f7dd6.name: Tactical Precision (Aura)
a090158f7dd6.plain: Aura: while one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

a0b6bd535c2a.name: 3. Plea of Deliverance
a0b6bd535c2a.plain:
If this litany is inspiring, pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE or BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER units within 6" of this PRIEST.
• Any psychic powers manifested by enemy models that are affecting that unit or its models stop affecting them.
• Until the start of your next Command phase, psychic powers manifested by enemy units don't affect that unit or its models.

a112524bdec1.name: Wisdom of the Ancients
a112524bdec1.plain:
Use in your Command phase. Pick one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT models that isn't a WULFEN or DEATH COMPANY model. It gains one of these abilities until the start of your next Command phase:
• Rites of Battle (Aura): while one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by that unit's models.
• Tactical Precision (Aura): while one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by that unit's models.

a19fe8a10868.name: Skilled Riders
a19fe8a10868.plain: Use in your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES BIKER, LAND SPEEDER or STORM SPEEDER units that Advanced is chosen as the target of a ranged attack. For the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack against that unit.

a2be00a15fc3.name: Wrecked
a2be00a15fc3.plain:
Whenever a model in this unit is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it and before any embarked models disembark. On a 6, its stores explode: every unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds. On any other roll, the building is wrecked: it still counts as destroyed for every rule, but it stays on the battlefield and, for the rest of the battle, is an Obstacle terrain feature with these terrain traits:
• Difficult Ground
• Exposed Position
• Unstable Position

waive.40000: part of the rules title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Rules"

a2e787e1b6bc.name: Morkai's Teeth Bolts
a2e787e1b6bc.plain: When you give a model this Relic, pick one bolt weapon it has. When that model is chosen to shoot, you can have that weapon fire a Morkai's Teeth bolt. If you do, that weapon makes only one attack, but if it hits, the attack sequence ends and the target unit becomes marked by Morkai for the rest of the turn. Wound rolls of 1 are re-rolled for any attack made against a unit marked by Morkai.

a38aa3552578.name: Master-crafted instigator bolt carbine
a38aa3552578.plain: When you pick a target for this weapon, you can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule.

a3b26a16027e.name: Heretic’s Pyre
a3b26a16027e.plain:
Use at the start of your Shooting phase. Pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE units. Until the end of the phase:
• When a flame weapon from that unit targets a unit with 6 to 10 models, it makes at least 3 attacks.
• When a flame weapon from that unit targets a unit with 11 or more models, don't roll for the number of attacks; it makes the maximum number instead.
This Stratagem costs 2CP if the chosen unit is a MK X GRAVIS unit, and 1CP otherwise.

a4246bcaa7cf.name: Commanding Oratory
a4246bcaa7cf.plain: Use at the start of any of your phases except the Command phase. Pick one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHAPLAIN units that hasn't recited a litany this turn. It can recite one litany no friendly model has recited this turn yet; that litany is automatically inspiring (don't roll) and lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

a4a51e09614c.name: 1. Litany of Faith (Aura)
a4a51e09614c.plain: If this litany is inspiring, then while one of your CORE or CHARACTER units is within 6" of this PRIEST, roll one D6 whenever one of its models would lose a wound to a mortal wound: on a 5+, that wound isn't lost.

a55e6ecf34b0.name: 4. Mantra of Strength
a55e6ecf34b0.plain: If this litany is inspiring, this PRIEST'S Attacks and Strength characteristics each go up by 1, and so does the Damage characteristic of each melee weapon it has.

a5b3b1176b7a.name: Explodes (D6+6"/D6)
a5b3b1176b7a.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within D6+6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

a6cd6899c84c.name: Archangel's Shard
a6cd6899c84c.plain: Attacks from this weapon that are allocated to a model in a CHAOS unit have Damage 3. Attacks from this weapon that are allocated to a model in a CHAOS MONSTER unit have Damage 4.

a6f686b1c9d6.name: Targeter Optics
a6f686b1c9d6.plain: The bearer adds 1 to the hit roll of every ranged attack it makes with a Heavy weapon.

a804f2aa7130.name: Honour or Death
a804f2aa7130.plain: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention when an enemy unit is within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of it, rather than the usual 3" horizontally and 5" vertically. When it makes a Heroic Intervention move, it can move up to 6", provided it finishes either nearer to the nearest enemy model or within Engagement Range of an enemy CHARACTER unit. All other Heroic Intervention rules still apply.

aa2061a1b953.name: Sigismund's Heir
aa2061a1b953.plain: You can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll for each melee attack this model makes against an enemy Character unit.

aa644b2c775d.name: Hover Tank
aa644b2c775d.plain: Always measure distances and ranges to and from this model's hull, ignoring its base.

ac233a907218.name: 5. Recitation of Focus
ac233a907218.plain: If this litany is inspiring, pick one of your CORE or CHARACTER units within 6" of this PRIEST. Add 1 to the hit roll for every ranged attack made by a model in that unit.

ad833d1ce6e5.name: Automated Weapons
ad833d1ce6e5.plain:
Each time a model in this unit is chosen to shoot in your Shooting phase while no friendly units are embarked inside it, that weapon's attacks can only target one of these:
• the closest eligible enemy unit, or
• the closest eligible enemy AIRCRAFT unit.

ad9a67f669b3.name: Mindless Followers
ad9a67f669b3.plain: While this unit has any Cenobyte Servitor models, each attack that successfully wounds this unit must be allocated to one of them. Ignore destroyed Cenobyte Servitor models for Morale tests. If Chaplain Grimaldus is destroyed, any Cenobyte Servitors left in this unit are destroyed too. Cenobyte Servitor models can't be your Warlord.

af05dd6e5455.name: Champion of the Feast
af05dd6e5455.plain: Use before the battle (only once). Pick one BLACK TEMPLARS model from your army whose profile includes the word 'Sergeant' or 'Sword Brother'. Add 1 to its Attacks and Wounds characteristics, and improve its Weapon Skill characteristic by 1.

b0ad7c73d28d.name: Steady Advance
b0ad7c73d28d.plain: Use in your Movement phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units makes a Normal Move. Until the end of the turn, it counts as having Remained Stationary.

b25c23de0abc.name: Xiphon missile battery
b25c23de0abc.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll for each attack made with this weapon against an AIRCRAFT unit.

b3a87a87c660.name: Command Squad
b3a87a87c660.plain: If a Detachment has a <CHAPTER> CAPTAIN in it, you can include one <CHAPTER> COMPANY VETERANS unit in that Detachment without it using a Battlefield Role slot.

b41fb7ffd467.name: Cerberus neutron pulse array
b41fb7ffd467.plain: Each attack from this weapon that is allocated to a model has a Damage characteristic of 6 when the bearer Remained Stationary during your previous Movement phase.

b4e543afea4f.name: The Emperor’s Will
b4e543afea4f.plain:
Use in your Shooting phase. Pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS INFANTRY units that Advanced this turn. Until the end of the phase:
• It can still shoot, but only with Pistol, Rapid Fire or Assault weapons.
• Its models ignore the hit roll penalty for shooting Assault weapons.

b50c0ade8da2.name: 5. Fervent Acclamation
b50c0ade8da2.plain: If this litany is inspiring, pick one Templar Vow that isn't in effect, and one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE or BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER units within 6" of this Priest. That unit gets the effects of that vow.

waive.44: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule
waive.45: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

b62f990ad9d3.name: Chief Apothecary
b62f990ad9d3.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model may use Combat Restoratives twice, not just once.

b66ca50887c7.name: Bolt sniper rifle - Executioner round
b66ca50887c7.plain: You can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when picking targets for this weapon. Add 1 to the hit roll for attacks made with it, and the target gets no benefit of cover to its saving throw.

b70ed1981e32.name: Reliquary of Vengeance
b70ed1981e32.plain: Once per battle, a model with this Relic can reveal the reliquary at the start of the Fight phase. If it does, until that phase ends the bearer has this Aura ability (Reliquary of Vengeance): while one of your Ultramarines Core or Ultramarines Character units is within 6" of the bearer, each model in that unit gets 1 extra attack.

b72a06b4de6f.name: Smoke Launchers
b72a06b4de6f.plain: Once per game, in the Shooting phase, this model can use its smoke launchers instead of shooting any of its weapons. If it does, until your next Shooting phase, your opponent subtracts 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target it.

b77ef2c06134.name: 4. Fires of Devotion
b77ef2c06134.plain: If this litany is inspiring, pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE or BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER units within 6" of this Priest. When that unit fights, if this turn it made a charge move, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its models.

b785e0c87906.name: Swiftclaw
b785e0c87906.plain:
If this unit belongs to the Space Wolves Chapter or one of its successors, it gains the SWIFTCLAW keyword and is made up of 1 Biker Sergeant and 2-14 Space Marine Bikers.
Its Power Rating depends on how many Space Marine Biker models it has: 3 to 5 models, Power Rating 9; 6 to 8 models, Power Rating 14; 9 to 11 models, Power Rating 18; 12 or more models, Power Rating 23. If it includes an Attack Bike, it gets Power Rating +2.

b7c514c7ccb2.name: Narthecium [Aura]
b7c514c7ccb2.plain: Aura: if a model in a friendly <CHAPTER> INFANTRY or <CHAPTER> BIKER unit would lose a wound while its unit is within 3" of this model, roll one D6. On a 6, it doesn't lose that wound.

b7c54db50848.name: Relic Shield
b7c54db50848.plain: Add 1 to the bearer's armour saves. Whenever the bearer suffers a mortal wound, roll one D6: on a 4+ that mortal wound has no effect.

b857bed40adc.name: Bodyguard
b857bed40adc.plain: Enemy models can't make ranged attacks against a friendly <CHAPTER> CHARACTER unit whose Wounds characteristic is 9 or less while that CHARACTER unit is within 3" of this unit.

b8922c59e441.name: Quake Bolts
b8922c59e441.plain: When you give a model this Relic, pick one bolt weapon it has. When that model is chosen to shoot, you can have that weapon fire a quake bolt. If you do, that weapon makes only one attack, but if it hits, the target unit is felled until the end of the turn, on top of any normal damage. Add 1 to the hit roll of every melee attack made against a felled unit.

b9693aa8a728.name: Boreas air defence missiles
b9693aa8a728.plain: Add 2 to the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon against an AIRCRAFT unit. Attacks from this weapon allocated to an AIRCRAFT model have Damage D3+3.

b974c645dceb.name: Death from Above
b974c645dceb.plain: During deployment, if every model in this unit has this ability, you can set it up high in the skies instead of on the battlefield. If you do, it can arrive in the Reinforcements step of any of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models.

b988439a0456.name: Airborne
b988439a0456.plain: This model can't charge. Only units that can FLY can charge it, and in the Fight phase it can only attack, or be attacked by, units that can FLY.

ba8f02d71bdb.name: Martial Superiority
ba8f02d71bdb.plain: When the Fight phase starts, this model can fight first that phase if it is in Engagement Range of any enemy Character units.

bbc20a0a7e4b.name: Skilful Parry
bbc20a0a7e4b.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each melee attack made against this model.

bdbf3281d2d9.name: Grav-flux bombard
bdbf3281d2d9.plain: Blast. When an attack from this weapon is allocated to a model whose Save characteristic is 3+ or better, that attack has Damage 3.

bddb36d7f596.name: Auto Boltstorm Gauntlets (Melee)
bddb36d7f596.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit rolls for attacks made with this weapon.

bec775ed8d49.name: Aquilon Optics
bec775ed8d49.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll each time this model attacks with its heavy laser destroyer or macro plasma incinerator.

bfd9b8fbd18e.name: Transport
bfd9b8fbd18e.plain: This model has a transport capacity of 10 <CHAPTER> INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR, WULFEN and JUMP PACK models each count as two models, and CENTURION models each count as three. PRIMARIS models can't be carried.

c000386b326d.name: Camo cloaks
c000386b326d.plain: When a ranged attack is allocated to a model in this unit that has a camo cloak, and that model is receiving the benefits of cover, add a further 1 to any armour saving throw made against it.

c03ea70a0717.name: Leviathan siege drill
c03ea70a0717.plain: When an attack from this weapon is allocated to a VEHICLE model, its Damage is 6 for that attack.

c1ebf8e8670e.name: Gravis Fighting Styles
c1ebf8e8670e.plain:
Each time the bearer fights:
• if this model has an Astartes chainsword, it can make 2 extra attacks with it (for a maximum of 3).
• if it has a power sword, it can make 2 extra attacks with it.
• if it has a power fist, it can make 1 extra attack with it.
You can't use this ability with a Relic that replaces any of these weapons.

c2b6f69deef3.name: Master of the Forge
c2b6f69deef3.plain: When this model uses its Blessing of the Omnissiah ability to repair a model, the repaired model regains up to 3 lost wounds rather than D3.

c3a2c8ce88cf.name: Great Wolf Claw
c3a2c8ce88cf.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll for attacks made with this weapon.

c421821a2582.name: Attendant Thrall's Fists
c421821a2582.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 2 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can make no more than 2 attacks with this weapon.

c4320f665f29.name: Vows
c4320f665f29.plain:
If all units in your army have the BLACK TEMPLARS keyword (ignoring UNALIGNED units), then each unit in a BLACK TEMPLARS Detachment with the Combat Doctrines ability gains the Templar Vows ability.

Templar Vows: when the Read Mission Briefing step ends, you can choose one vow from this list:
• Uphold the Honour of the Emperor
• Suffer Not the Unclean to Live
• Accept any Challenge, No Matter the Odds
• Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch
Until the battle ends, every unit from your army that has the Templar Vows ability gains that vow's effects. Every vow brings some abilities and also a passion, which is a drawback that applies to Black Templars units while that vow affects them.

waive.44: page reference to the codex ("pages 44-45"), not part of the rule
waive.45: page reference to the codex ("pages 44-45"), not part of the rule

c566df23f8cb.name: Signum
c566df23f8cb.plain: In your Shooting phase, each time this unit shoots, if it has a Sergeant, you can pick one model in it. That model has Ballistic Skill 2+ until the end of the phase.

c590c741ba32.name: 2. Catechism of Fire
c590c741ba32.plain: If this litany is inspiring, pick one of your CORE or CHARACTER units within 6" of this PRIEST. When a model in that unit shoots at the closest eligible target, add 1 to the wound roll for each of those ranged attacks.

c59c52f48746.name: Open-topped
c59c52f48746.plain: Units embarked on this model can shoot in their Shooting phase; measure range and line of sight from any point on this model. Any restrictions or modifiers that apply to this model then apply to those passengers too. While this transport is within Engagement Range of any enemy units, the units inside it can only shoot with Pistols.

c7bac886373d.name: Heavy Armour
c7bac886373d.plain: Models with this ability get a 5+ invulnerable save.

c85b9c698bd5.name: Gene-wrought Might
c85b9c698bd5.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your PRIMARIS units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, each unmodified hit roll of 6 for a melee attack by a model in that unit automatically wounds the target.

c895bbe12852.name: Dreadnought chainfist
c895bbe12852.plain: An attack from this weapon that is allocated to a Vehicle model has a Damage of 6.

c8a14db57b74.name: Omni-scrambler
c8a14db57b74.plain: No enemy unit arriving as reinforcements can be placed within 12" of this model.

c903a638cc81.name: Orbital Bombardment
c903a638cc81.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, while your ADEPTUS ASTARTES WARLORD is on the battlefield: place a marker on any point of the battlefield. When your next Command phase starts, roll one D6 for every unit within 6" of the marker's centre; add 1 to the roll if the unit is within 3" of the centre, and subtract 1 if it is a CHARACTER. On a 2-5 the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6+ it suffers D6 mortal wounds. Then remove the marker.

c9f2f79244fe.name: Total Obliteration
c9f2f79244fe.plain: In your Shooting phase, each time this unit is chosen to shoot, if it hasn't Advanced this turn, it can unleash total obliteration. If it does, choose one enemy unit. This phase the unit's models may shoot twice, but they can only make attacks against that enemy unit (and only when it is an eligible target for those attacks).

cb376f0c8bc2.name: Terror Troops (Aura)
cb376f0c8bc2.plain: Aura: each enemy unit within 3" of this unit has 2 subtracted from its models' Leadership characteristic.

cb95e865c438.name: Korvidari Bolts
cb95e865c438.plain: When you give a model this Relic, pick one bolt weapon it has. When that model is chosen to shoot, you can have that weapon fire a korvidari bolt.
