If you do, add 6" to that weapon's Range characteristic when choosing targets and ranged weapons for that model, and it can target units that aren't visible to the bearer, but that weapon can make only one attack.

cbc4d4868b0f.name: Flakk Missile
cbc4d4868b0f.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY models targets an AIRCRAFT unit with a missile launcher. That weapon makes only one attack this phase, but add 1 to its hit roll. If it hits, the target suffers 2D3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.

ccd84c9fa097.name: Explodes (3"/D3)
ccd84c9fa097.plain: When this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll one D6 before it is removed from the battlefield and before any models embarked in it disembark. On a 6, it explodes: each unit within 3" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

cd4e767ccc1e.name: Explodes
cd4e767ccc1e.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll a D6 before any embarked models disembark and before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within D6+6" suffers 2D6 mortal wounds.

ce1080b0615d.name: Explodes (6"/1)
ce1080b0615d.plain: Roll one D6 when this model is destroyed, before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 6" takes 1 mortal wound.

cee214cc729a.name: Twin Falchion volcano cannon
cee214cc729a.plain: Blast. You can re-roll the wound roll for each attack made with this weapon against a TITANIC unit.

cf090711d881.name: Rites of Battle (Aura)
cf090711d881.plain: Aura: while one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

d17b154040dc.name: Hand Flamer
d17b154040dc.plain: Attacks with this weapon hit automatically; don't make a hit roll.

d1c81d7b6a17.name: Saboteur Explosive Pack
d1c81d7b6a17.plain: Use when one of your SABOTEUR EXPLOSIVE PACK units is chosen to Fall Back. Before it moves, pick one enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6, with 3 added to the result against a BUILDING unit. On a 2-5 the target suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6+ it suffers D6 mortal wounds.

d22d3966c4a2.name: Blessing of the Omnissiah
d22d3966c4a2.plain: When your Movement phase ends, this model can repair one <CHAPTER> VEHICLE that is within 3" of it; that VEHICLE gets back D3 lost wounds. No model can be repaired more than once per turn.

d313515e97dc.name: Adaptive Strategy
d313515e97dc.plain: Use in your Command phase, while your army has an active combat doctrine and your <CHAPTER> WARLORD is on the battlefield. Pick one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, the Devastator, Tactical and Assault Doctrines all count as active for every attack its models make.

d34f015d0c24.name: Deathwing
d34f015d0c24.plain: This unit gains the DEATHWING keyword if it belongs to the Dark Angels or to a successor Chapter of the Dark Angels.

d3522b8745df.name: Shard of Isstvan
d3522b8745df.plain: A model with this Relic has 1 added to its Attacks characteristic. Also, Morale tests taken for <CHAPTER> units within 6" of a friendly model with this Relic are passed automatically; don't roll the dice.

d370289ccf2f.name: Watcher's in the Dark
d370289ccf2f.plain: Up to two times in a battle, this model may try a Deny the Witch test as though it had the PSYKER keyword. If a CHAOS PSYKER is manifesting the power, you may re-roll that test.

d3c2884054e9.name: A Storm of Death
d3c2884054e9.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your VANGUARD SPEARHEAD REIVER SQUAD units is chosen to fight. Until the end of the phase, each unmodified wound roll of 6 for a melee attack a model in that unit makes against an INFANTRY or BIKER unit inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target as well as its normal damage (up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

d4335fa53118.name: Void Shields
d4335fa53118.plain:
This model has 2 void shields, each with 3 shield points. As long as at least one void shield is up, this model has a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

When this model fails a saving throw against a ranged attack while it still has a void shield, it suffers no damage; instead, each point of damage inflicted removes 1 shield point from one of its void shields. After a void shield has lost any shield points, it keeps taking all further damage until it collapses. When an attack takes a void shield down to 0 shield points, that shield collapses: this model loses it, and any excess damage from that attack is lost. Void shields never stop mortal wounds (each mortal wound still makes this model lose one wound as normal).

When your Command phase starts, any void shield on this model with fewer than 3 shield points left is restored to 3 shield points.

d4ea1313eb83.name: Revered Repositories
d4ea1313eb83.plain: Use before the battle, while mustering your army; you can only use it once. Pick one BLACK TEMPLARS model from your army whose profile includes the word 'Sergeant' or 'Sword Brother'. Even though it isn't a CHARACTER, it can have one of these Relics of the Eternal Crusade: Witchseeker Bolts, Sword of Judgement, Skull of the Cacodominus, Master-crafted Weapon or Digital Weapons. Every Relic in your army must be different, and you can't use this Stratagem to give one model two Relics.

d4f9ebcfc3eb.name: Arma Luminis
d4f9ebcfc3eb.plain: Before you pick targets, choose one or both of the profiles below to attack with.

d53f9db0f079.name: Subterranean Assault
d53f9db0f079.plain: During deployment, instead of placing this model on the battlefield you can set it up underground, together with any units embarked inside it. At the end of any of your Movement phases, it can make a subterranean assault: place it anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from all enemy models. Units inside can then disembark immediately, but must be placed more than 9" from all enemy models. Models that can't be placed because there isn't room are destroyed.

d63a645e4247.name: Strength of Conviction
d63a645e4247.plain: Use in your Command phase. Pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE units. It has the Objective Secured ability until the start of your next Command phase.

d6ce2705f47e.name: Termite Drill
d6ce2705f47e.plain: Each attack from this weapon that is allocated to a VEHICLE model has a Damage characteristic of D3+6.

d71082d58280.name: Uphold the Honour of the Emperor
d71082d58280.plain: Use at the start of the Fight phase. Pick one of your SWORD BRETHREN units. Until the end of that phase, each time a model in that unit loses a wound, roll a D6: on a 5+, the wound isn't lost.

d7260e3ccf76.name: Twin plasma gun, Supercharge
d7260e3ccf76.plain: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain once all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

d74674d6b842.name: Gleaming Pinions
d74674d6b842.plain:
• Falling Back in a turn doesn't stop the bearer from charging that turn.
• Charge rolls for the bearer can be re-rolled.

d81ad866e860.name: Tremor Shells
d81ad866e860.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when you pick a target for one of your THUNDERFIRE CANNON models. For the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the wound roll of each ranged attack it makes. Each time one of those attacks hits a target that isn't TITANIC and can't FLY, the target unit's models have their Move characteristic halved, and it subtracts 2 from its Advance and charge rolls, until the start of your next Movement phase.

d93197acb9fb.name: Narthecium (Aura)
d93197acb9fb.plain: Aura: if a model in a friendly <CHAPTER> INFANTRY or <CHAPTER> BIKER unit would lose a wound while its unit is within 3" of this model, roll one D6. On a 6, it doesn't lose that wound.

da13919f5a89.name: Command Squad Bodyguard
da13919f5a89.plain: If a friendly <CHAPTER> CHARACTER model that is within 3" of this unit would lose wounds because of an attack against it, this unit can try to block that attack: roll one D6. On a 2+, the CHARACTER keeps those wounds and this unit suffers 1 mortal wound for every one of them. You can only try to intercept each attack once.

db04978fd414.name: Explodes (2D6"/D6)
db04978fd414.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within 2D6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

db87fa5ba390.name: Combat Revival
db87fa5ba390.plain: Use at the end of your Movement phase. Pick one of your <CHAPTER> APOTHECARY units, then pick a friendly <CHAPTER> INFANTRY or <CHAPTER> BIKER unit that is within 3" of that <CHAPTER> APOTHECARY and below its Starting Strength (an INVADER ATV SQUAD can't be picked). Return one destroyed model to that unit, with its full wounds.

dcdeb12aef38.name: Explodes
dcdeb12aef38.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll a D6 before any embarked models disembark and before you take it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within 2D6" suffers 2D6 mortal wounds.

dce072811ae0.name: Nobility Made Manifest (Aura)
dce072811ae0.plain: Aura: while your ULTRAMARINES INFANTRY and ULTRAMARINES BIKER units are within 6" of this Warlord, they can perform Heroic Interventions as if they were CHARACTERS.

dd3a2ce06bda.name: Communication Relay
dd3a2ce06bda.plain: If your WARLORD is embarked inside the bearer during your Command phase, you get 1CP.

de113122bf14.name: Explorator Augury Web
de113122bf14.plain: Enemy units arriving as reinforcements can't be set up within 12" of the bearer. The bearer's transport capacity is reduced from 10 to 6 <CHAPTER> INFANTRY models.

de3656f3f3f9.name: Servant of the Chapter
de3656f3f3f9.plain: This unit can't be upgraded to a MASTER OF SANCTITY.

de9bf4f9e53b.name: Skillful Parry
de9bf4f9e53b.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each melee attack made against this model.

df1d577a6597.name: Wrecker
df1d577a6597.plain: If this model is equipped with an ironclad combat weapon, re-roll any hit roll of 1 for its melee attacks.

dffd5401775d.name: Armour of Contempt
dffd5401775d.plain: Use in any phase, when a mortal wound would make one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE models lose a wound. Until the end of the phase, each time a mortal wound would make that model lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, the wound isn't lost.

e28dee94c7f6.name: Supersonic
e28dee94c7f6.plain: Whenever this model makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, start by pivoting it on the spot up to 90° (this pivot is free and doesn't use up any of its move), then move it straight forwards. After that first pivot it can't pivot again.

e2caa04fbf70.name: Digital Weapons
e2caa04fbf70.plain: The bearer of this Relic can make 1 extra attack each time it fights, using the close combat weapon profile. If that attack hits, it inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target and its attack sequence ends.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 rulebook"

e3e35c33a026.name: Black Sword - Thrusting Strike
e3e35c33a026.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made with this profile.

e673ce0932c7.name: Spiritual Leaders (Aura)
e673ce0932c7.plain: Aura: while one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models can choose to use this model's Leadership characteristic rather than their own.

e6bf9d28b889.name: Tactical Augury
e6bf9d28b889.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your VANGUARD SPEARHEAD units is chosen to shoot. Until the end of the phase, targets of ranged attacks made by its models don't get the benefit of cover against those attacks.

e75f7808921b.name: Devout Push
e75f7808921b.plain:
Use at the start of the Fight phase. Pick one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CORE or BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER units, then choose one:
• If it isn't within Engagement Range of an enemy unit, it makes a Normal Move of up to 3". It must finish that move closer to either the closest enemy unit or the closest objective marker, and it can't use this move to embark within a TRANSPORT model.
• If it is within Engagement Range of any enemy units, it makes a pile-in move.

e88ada4e6849.name: Icarus stormcannon
e88ada4e6849.plain: Against an AIRCRAFT unit, each attack from this weapon makes 2 hit rolls instead of 1, with 1 added to each of those hit rolls.

e8b14adebfbc.name: Aquilon Optics
e8b14adebfbc.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll each time this model attacks with a Lancer laser destroyer.

e8c291b99fe3.name: Stormwrath Bolts
e8c291b99fe3.plain: When you give a model this Relic, pick one bolt weapon it has. When the bearer shoots with that weapon, you can have it fire a stormwrath bolt. If you do, that weapon makes only one attack, but for that attack it has Strength 7 and Armour Penetration -1, and Damage D6 if the target is a MONSTER.

e8dfddcc3a95.name: Wolf Guard
e8dfddcc3a95.plain: This unit gains the WOLF GUARD keyword if it belongs to the Space Wolves or to a successor Chapter of the Space Wolves.

eba77a7865a1.name: Relic of the Chapter
eba77a7865a1.plain: Use before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the ADEPTUS ASTARTES keyword. Pick one ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER model from your army and give it one Chapter Relic it is allowed to have. Every Relic in your army must be different, and you can't use this Stratagem to give one model two Relics. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

ecdc69d75a90.name: Obsidian Aquila
ecdc69d75a90.plain: While one of your SALAMANDERS CORE units is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 6, the wound is not lost.

ed04810237e5.name: Automated Emplacement
ed04810237e5.plain: Whenever a model in this unit shoots, its attacks must target the closest eligible enemy unit that can FLY, or, if no eligible units can FLY, the closest eligible unit. This unit can never charge or Heroically Intervene, and it can't pile in or consolidate.

ed05b4d40708.name: Deathwing Command Squad
ed05b4d40708.plain: If this unit belongs to the Dark Angels Chapter or one of its successors, it gains the DEATHWING keyword. For every DEATHWING COMMAND SQUAD unit in a Detachment, you can include one DEATHWING ANCIENT unit in that Detachment without it using a Battlefield Role slot.

eec25b78dd67.name: Shock and Awe
eec25b78dd67.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES SHOCK GRENADES or LAND SPEEDER STORM units is chosen to shoot. Pick one enemy unit within 6" of it. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend, and subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack its models make.

efdbc5437d6c.name: 6. Oath of Glory
efdbc5437d6c.plain:
If this litany is inspiring:
• If any enemy units are within Engagement Range of this PRIEST model when the Fight phase starts, it can fight first that phase.
• When this PRIEST model attacks using a Crozius arcanum, an artificer crozius or a Relic replacing either of them, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 2 extra hits.
• This PRIEST model gets 1 added to its Strength characteristic.

f0055acc971f.name: Teleport Homer
f0055acc971f.plain: Once per battle, at the start of your Movement phase, you may take this unit off the battlefield. Then, in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, it may be set up again, either wholly within your own deployment zone or within 3" of a friendly <CHAPTER> model, and in both cases more than 9" away from all enemy models. If the battle ends while this unit is off the battlefield, it is destroyed. If this unit has split in two using its Combat Squads ability, only one of the two units can use Teleport Homer.

f101406da1c5.name: Vindicator siege shield
f101406da1c5.plain: The bearer adds 1 to its armour saving throws against ranged attacks allocated to it.

f1b25a4f61df.name: 6. Canticle of Hate (Aura)
f1b25a4f61df.plain:
If this litany is inspiring, then while one of your CORE or CHARACTER units is within 6" of this PRIEST:
• add 2 to that unit's charge rolls (this doesn't stack with any other rule that adds to a unit's charge roll).
• when a model in that unit piles in or consolidates, it can move up to 3" further (this doesn't stack with any other rule that increases how far models can pile in or consolidate).

f3af76b3a3c3.name: Xenophase blade
f3af76b3a3c3.plain: Your opponent can't make invulnerable saves against attacks made with this weapon.

f5284757511b.name: Remnant of the Fallen Temple
f5284757511b.plain: The bearer has this Aura ability (Remnant of the Fallen Temple): while one of your BLACK TEMPLAR CORE or BLACK TEMPLAR CHARACTER units is within 6" of this unit, each time a model in that unit would lose a wound, the wound is not lost on a 6+.

f5819c24c790.name: Company Heroes
f5819c24c790.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each LIEUTENANT unit in a Detachment lets you include a second LIEUTENANT unit in that Detachment without using up an extra Battlefield Role slot.

f646d922e6bb.name: Awaken the Machine Spirits
f646d922e6bb.plain: In your Command phase, this model can awaken one of your <CHAPTER> VEHICLE models that is within 3" of it. Until your next Command phase starts, add 1 to the hit roll for every ranged attack made by that VEHICLE model. No model can be awakened more than once per turn.

f6951c6b22c2.name: Master of Battle (Aura)
f6951c6b22c2.plain:
Aura: while a friendly IMPERIUM unit is within 12" of Roboute Guilliman:
• Add 1 to its Advance and charge rolls.
• Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by its models.
• You can re-roll its Morale tests.

f8f59f7cd692.name: Artillery and Crew
f8f59f7cd692.plain: Each Rapier Carrier and its crew count as one model for all rules purposes, and the crew models must stay within 1" of their Rapier Carrier. So the crew can't be targeted or attacked on their own, and visibility and all ranges are measured to and from the Rapier Carrier model, not the crew. This unit can't Advance, is never eligible to charge or Heroically Intervene, and can't make pile-in or consolidation moves.

f9543f7fcc7c.name: The Avenging Son
f9543f7fcc7c.plain: In a Battle-forged army, this model has to be your Warlord, even when some other model in your army has a rule saying it must be the Warlord.

f95b819f740e.name: Crusader’s Wrath
f95b819f740e.plain: Use once per battle, in your Command phase, while your army's Assault Doctrine is active. Until your next Command phase starts, whenever a BLACK TEMPLARS model from your army attacks using a Pistol or Melee weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1. This adds to the Assault Doctrine bonus.

f9a66b143cab.name: Bellicastus Missile Array - Icarus
f9a66b143cab.plain: Blast. Add 1 to the hit roll for each attack made with this weapon against an Aircraft unit.

f9b2cb1291cb.name: Abhor the Witch
f9b2cb1291cb.plain: Use in your opponent's Psychic phase, after an enemy PSYKER unit passes a Psychic test and after any attempt to Deny the Witch. If any BLACK TEMPLARS unit from your army is within 24" of that PSYKER unit, roll one D6; on a 4+, the psychic power is denied.

fa52e1473cff.name: Stronghold
fa52e1473cff.plain:
Once it is set up, each model in this unit counts as a separate terrain feature with these Terrain Traits:
• Defensible
• Light Cover
• Heavy Cover
• Obscuring

waive.40000: part of the rules title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Rules"

faad7a4ac5c4.name: Centurion assault launcher
faad7a4ac5c4.plain: The bearer's unit has the ASSAULT LAUNCHERS keyword as long as the bearer is on the battlefield.

fadd114975fb.name: Auto-Medicae Bionics
fadd114975fb.plain: When your turn starts, a model with this Relic that has lost any wounds gets back up to D3 of them.

fb825afebe85.name: The Emperor's Sword
fb825afebe85.plain: Each unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon inflicts D3 mortal wounds on the target as well as any other damage.

fd0a8c6f03db.name: Ironhail Sytalon Array
fd0a8c6f03db.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll for each attack made with this weapon against an Aircraft unit.

fd46199a10fd.name: Arcus multi-launcher
fd46199a10fd.plain: Blast. This weapon may target units not visible to the target.

fdc4796c6010.name: Combat shield
fdc4796c6010.plain: The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save, and you add 1 to armour saving throws made for it.

fe204a960d25.name: Black Rage
fe204a960d25.plain:
• This unit can't Fall Back when it is chosen to move in your Movement phase.
• When this unit fights after making a charge move or a Heroic Intervention this turn, add 1 to its models' Attacks characteristic until that fight is over.
• Roll one D6 each time one of this unit's models would lose a wound: on a 6, it doesn't lose that wound.
• This unit can't perform Actions.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core book"

fef74fe99a48.name: Melta Bomb
fef74fe99a48.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES MELTA BOMB units is chosen to fight. Pick one model in that unit: this phase it can only make one attack, which must target an enemy VEHICLE unit, but if it hits, that unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.
